title: Decoding News Narratives: A Critical Analysis of Large Language Models in Framing Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and FLAN-T5) using zero-shot, few-shot, and explainable prompting to detect whether news headlines contain intentional framing, tested on the Gun Violence Frame Corpus (GVFC) and a custom 'In The Wild' dataset.
Analyzing model prediction errors to identify if LLMs exhibit a biased tendency to mistakenly classify emotionally charged language or expressions of emotion as intentional media framing.
